Done. Both definition-of-done checks pass, and CI's other gate stages are green too.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `bun run typecheck` | passes |
| `bun test` | 11 pass, 0 fail (9 new comment tests) |
| `bun run lint`, `guren check`, `guren audit` | clean, no new warnings |

**What the feature does**

- **Commenting.** `POST /posts/:id/comments` takes `{ body }` (1 to 2000 chars after trimming, validated by a route-bound zod schema so failures answer exactly like an invalid post title) and redirects to the post. Guests hit the existing `auth` middleware and land on `/login`.
- **Deleting.** `DELETE /comments/:id` is gated by a new CommentPolicy: the comment's author or the post's author gets a redirect to the post and the row plus its reports are removed in a transaction. Anyone else gets 403.
- **Reporting.** `POST /comments/:id/report` always answers 204. A `(comment_id, user_id)` unique constraint plus an existence check make a repeat report a no-op.
- **Hiding.** The post page filters out comments with three or more report rows. They stay in `comments` for later review.
- **Post page.** Props gain `comments` as `{ id, body, author: { id, name }, createdAt }`, oldest first. The page lists them, shows a comment box when signed in, and offers Delete where the viewer is allowed to use it and Report for any signed-in user. Report goes through the generated API client, which carries the CSRF token, then reloads the `comments` prop.
- **Cascade.** Deleting a post removes its comments and their reports explicitly inside a transaction, on top of `ON DELETE CASCADE` in the schema, because SQLite only enforces foreign keys when the connection turns them on.

**Summary of changes.** Schema tables `comments` and `comment_reports` were added to `db/schema.ts` with a generated migration under `db/migrations/20260925050815_add_comments/`. New files: `app/Models/Comment.ts` (with the hide threshold constant and `author`/`post` relations), `app/Models/CommentReport.ts`, `app/Policies/CommentPolicy.ts`, `app/Http/Validators/CommentValidator.ts`, `app/Http/Resources/CommentResource.ts`, `app/Http/Controllers/CommentController.ts` (store, destroy, report), and `tests/CommentController.test.ts`. Edited: `routes/web.ts` registers `posts.comments.store`, `comments.destroy` and `comments.report` under the `auth` middleware; `app/Providers/AuthorizationProvider.ts` binds the CommentPolicy; `app/Models/Post.ts` gains a `comments` hasMany relation; `app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts` adds visible comments to `show` and cascades comment deletion in `destroy`; `resources/js/pages/posts/Show.tsx` renders the comment list, form and Delete/Report controls; and the `.guren/*.gen.ts` files were regenerated with `bun run codegen`.
